(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [17,18])for(const roll of [false,true]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:PT8.makeAI({n:7,classes:['A'],skill:.88,rally:false}),trackRace:true,rolling:roll});const cs=RACE.cars.filter(c=>!c.human);const d0=cs.map(c=>c.unw||0);const mx=cs.map(()=>0);const ex=cs.map(()=>0);for(let i=0;i<60*14;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';cs.forEach((c,k)=>{const dd=(c.unw||0)-d0[k];if(c.lane0!=null&&dd*RACE.T.sp<100){mx[k]=Math.max(mx[k],Math.abs(PT8.latOf(RACE.T,c)-c.lane0))}if(c.exp>0)ex[k]=1})}out[tr+(roll?'R':'S')]={dev:mx.map(v=>v.toFixed(1)).join(','),ex:ex.join(''),cls:cs.map(c=>c.cs.cls).join('')};PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
